newsitem.title: USA: Duke Catawba nuke at 65 pct and holding.
newsitem.headline: Duke Catawba nuke at 65 pct and holding.

text.p: Duke Power Co's 1,129 megawatt Catawba 2 nuclear unit was operating at 65 percent power early Tuesday and holding due to a valve failure, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said in its status report.

The unit was operating at 60 percent of capacity on Monday due to a condenser tube leak. As of Monday morning, those repairs had been completed and unit was expected to return to full service that morning, according to the NRC.
The adjacent unit 1, with an identical generating capacity, is operating at 100 percent of capacity.
Both units are located in Clover, S.C.
